# JT12

The RTL is copied from [jotego/jt12](https://github.com/jotego/jt12) at commit
`eebba1d` (2026-11-23), plus its `jt49` submodule at `947e2e1`. Only the files
`target/quartus/jt10.qip` lists are kept, under their repository paths.

JT12 is Copyright (C) Jose Tejada Gomez and licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later;
`COPYING` next to this file is its license. The component built from it
(`parts/ym2610.wasm`) is therefore GPL-3.0-or-later, while the rest of the
repository remains Apache-2.0. The example is not part of any published
crate or the npm package.
